verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises 'workflows' for SLAs, trial extensions, and discounts, automatic ticket resolution via the Fibi AI agent, and automatic shipped-notifications, all of which suggest background automations that fire without manual intervention. However, these are marketing-level claims with no technical documentation on configuring triggers/conditions, no explicit 'autonomous agent' framework details, and no independent corroboration of reliability. missing for 10: technical docs on workflow trigger/condition configuration, evidence of long-running autonomous agent behavior beyond marketing copy, independent hands-on validation.
